description: Search the public API index (AHOOK Search, 14,000+ callable APIs and MCP servers). Ranks for whether an agent can actually use a result: BM25 text relevance plus readiness (machine interface, declared auth, liveness, llms.txt, ownership, example call), freshness, authority, and completeness. Every result carries its score_breakdown. Auth: Authorization Bearer ahk_ account key header (create one with POST /api/v1/accounts). One search = 1 metered read (meter search_queries, included in the $1 base, no per-search charge in v1). Rate limit: free 10/min, paid 60/min.

category.description: Exact category match, e.g. tts, coding, ai-models, payments.

free_commercial.description: Only results whose free tier states commercial use.

query.description: Search terms. Empty = browse mode: highest score first.

name: search
